tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: The ground. Page and overlay backgrounds, channel art base, and the text color on every spectrum fill (pink, tangerine, lime, cyan, violet).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on void: cards, chat boxes, schedule tiles, overlay plates. All text colors here pass 4.5:1 on panel.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and panel outlines only (1.9:1 on void). Never the only edge of a control; use ink-muted for that.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on void and panel (17.8:1 / 15.8:1). Headlines, body copy, the wordmark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on void and panel (10.2:1 / 9.0:1): taglines, timestamps, captions, metadata. Also control borders and focus rings.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: The lead brand color. LIVE badges, primary buttons, the pop shadow, the biggest block in any layout. Text on it is void (5.8:1). As text it reads on void and panel (5.8:1 / 5.1:1).

tokens.name: tangerine
tokens.usage: Spectrum band 2. Highlights, new-follower alerts, warm accents. Text on it is void (8.3:1).

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Spectrum band 3 and the nerd color: HUD readouts, pixel patterns, the focus ring, 'gg' moments. Text on it is void (16.1:1); lime text reads on void at any size.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Spectrum band 4. Links, info states, secondary buttons, subscriber alerts. Text on it is void (12.0:1).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Spectrum band 5. Raid and community moments, tags, quiet accents. Text on it is void (6.3:1). Never in a gradient with cyan.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The wordmark, thumbnail titles, 'Starting soon' screens. One per surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section heads on panels and channel art, alert headlines.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, schedule days, lower-third names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pull up a chair, the dungeon can wait five minutes.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: New follower! Welcome to the party.
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body, button labels, alert body lines.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Streams Tue, Thu, Sat at 8pm CT
styles.usage: Taglines, timestamps, credits, small print. In ink-muted.

styles.name: hud
styles.usage: Badges, stat readouts, game tags, timers. Always uppercase. Lime or ink on void, void on a spectrum fill.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap inside badges and between icon and label; the pixel unit for patterns.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Padding inside buttons, chips and alert cards; gap between stacked lines of a lower third.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Safe margin from overlay and canvas edges; the width of one spectrum band.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: HUD chips, game tags, pixel-ish edges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, alert plates, webcam frames.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows only. No blur, ever.

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: The sticker shadow under primary buttons, alert plates and the webcam frame. Pink, offset down-right.

tokens.name: pop-lime
tokens.usage: The same shadow in lime for a pink element, so it never sits on its own color.
